summary: Frontend-only test of the catalogue and card restyle (Playwright at 1920, 1100, 1099, 860, 859 and 390). Working: the brand shortcut row filters the grid and updates the title and URL; the sticky bar has switch-rent/switch-buy (buy shows 6 bags), results-count and open-filters-button; the 'Filters & Sort' sheet; sort-select low/high orders prices correctly (50..240 and the reverse); brand, color, availability and auth filters plus Clear work; Beige returns only sample-08; the editorial tile spans 2 columns, links to /lend, and hides when a filter, brand or search is active; the hover crossfade to the worn image works on desktop; the desktop badge shows at >=860 and the mobile badge below 860; wishlist aria-pressed toggles, persists after reload and does not navigate; columns are 4/3/2 at 1100/1099/860/859; no horizontal overflow at 390 (scrollWidth 390, so the iteration-1 overflow is fixed); the home grid uses the new cards; the PDP gallery shows Front then 'Worn (editorial)'; booking works end to end (sample-03, 3 days, $1,101, Request sent). One real layout bug: the editorial tile leaves an empty grid cell at 3 and 2 columns.

ui_bugs.issue: The tile (col-span-2) is always inserted before item index 5. At 3 columns, row 2 holds sample-04 and sample-05, the 2-wide tile cannot fit in the last cell, so it wraps to the next row and leaves an empty cell at row 2 col 3 (seen at 1099 and 860). At 2 columns, sample-05 sits alone with an empty right cell. Only 4 columns is clean. Fix: add `grid-flow-row-dense` to the grid, or pick the insert index per column count so the tile starts at column 1 (e.g. index 6 for 3 or 2 columns).

The testid is `brand-shortcut-all`, not `brand-shortcut-view-all` as listed in the review request. It works; just a naming mismatch. The Hermès testid contains an accent (`brand-shortcut-hermès`, `filter-brand-hermès`). Consider normalizing it to ASCII.

issues: 'View all' and 'Chanel' show the exact same thumbnail (both use sample-01's first image), so the first two tiles look duplicated. Use a different image for View all, or the second Chanel bag.

The sample-01 (black Quilted Flap) hover/'Worn (editorial)' image is a woman in a burgundy dress holding a small black wallet-clutch, not the bag. Other worn images vary too. The editorial tile image (woman in a leather jacket) shows no handbag.
On the PDP, the Back/Side/Bottom/Hardware thumbnails reuse the same front studio shot, so the view labels promise different angles that are not shown.

Clear resets the filters but not sort. After choosing 'Price: high to low', Clear leaves the sort applied. Expected for 'Filters & Sort': reset sort to Featured as well (or label the button 'Clear filters').

When a sort is active with no filters, the editorial tile still appears at position 6 of the sorted list, which breaks the price sequence visually. Consider hiding the tile when sort is not 'recommended'.

action_items: Fix the editorial tile leaving an empty grid cell at 3-column and 2-column widths (grid-flow-row-dense, or choose the insert index so the tile starts at column 1)
Optional: a distinct 'View all' shortcut image; make Clear in the sheet also reset sort; hide the editorial tile when sorted; worn and editorial images that show the actual bag
critical_code_review_comments: Catalogue.jsx: the editorial insert at the hard-coded k===5 does not account for the responsive column count, which causes the grid holes
Catalogue.jsx: FilterSheet's reset prop does not call setSort('recommended')
ListingCard Wish: localStorage state is per card instance. Two cards for the same id on one page (home plus another grid) would not sync without a reload. This is minor.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (all requested flows pass; 1 medium layout bug)
